step1_empirical_bothbad.description: Per-system empirical BOTH_BAD rates from full dataset (3274 battles, 12 systems)

step2_grk_vs_empirical.description: Correlation between GRK-implied P(BOTH_BAD | k vs avg) and empirical BOTH_BAD rate

step3_rho_vs_neg_beta.description: Correlation between AB-MNL rho_k (badness) and -beta_k (negative skill)
step3_rho_vs_neg_beta.interpretation: Weak negative correlation. rho is NOT proportional to -beta; badness is decoupled from skill in AB-MNL. This suggests GRK's coupling assumption may not hold perfectly, but the near-zero rho values indicate minimal system-specific badness variation under AB-MNL.

step4_leaderboard.interpretation: Strong rank agreement (tau=0.82) between BT and GRK, but meaningful rank changes exist (e.g., musicgen-medium drops from BT rank ~7 to GRK rank 11 due to high BOTH_BAD).
